topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I can't believe this. They said the flight would be just a little late, but now it's been hours, and I’m stuck here, watching the world outside the terminal window as if it’s mocking me. All the while, the echoes of the airport announcements keep reminding me, as if I needed more reminders, that I'm not going anywhere anytime soon. And that event? Forget it. It’s a distant whisper now, a promise broken by time and by these incompetent fools who can’t even keep a plane on schedule. I should be there, not here, wasting my life in this soulless limbo.
